report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Arjun Mehta | Age: 63
Body Temperature at Scene: 26.5°C | Ambient Temperature: 21.1°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 6.8 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  2. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  3. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  4. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  5. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
